lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Gleice Leonardo Rocha de Souza | Lesson 25 -- Checkpoint 5 -- The Partner Meeting

listenings.text: Hi Gleice, it's Jennifer from NatureCare. Big news: the board read your proposal, and they like it! Thomas Grant will meet you on Thursday at nine, at his hotel on Paulista Avenue. This is the final meeting before the agreement. You have to bring three things: your plan for the first year, the list of pharmacy chains, and the name of your distributor. You don't have to bring samples, because Thomas will bring them from Boston. One piece of advice: you should talk about your experience at Sanofi. Thomas really trusts people with experience. And you shouldn't be shy about the commission. Eight percent is fair. Good luck, and send me a message after the meeting!

Hello again, I'm Daniel Reed. Today: how to close a meeting with a new partner. Many people have a great meeting, and then they leave with no plan. Here are four steps. Step one: say what you will do. For example: I will send the contract on Monday. Step two: say what the other person has to do, and what they don't have to do. Step three: make a polite request. Say: Would you confirm the date of the launch? Step four: give one piece of advice for the next step. For example: we should meet again in three months. And remember: you should send a follow-up email the same day. A good closing builds trust, and trust builds business.

extra_audio.text: First, Gleice arrives at the hotel on time. Then she says she will visit thirty pharmacy chains. After that, she explains that the distributor has to deliver every week. Next, she asks: would you confirm the agreement? Finally, she says they should meet again in three months.
